abstract: Evaluates mobile backup power autonomy, generator status, and primary dewar equipment capacities
system_message:
You are the Cryogenic Systems Engineer (CSE). Your responsibilities include evaluating mobile backup power autonomy, generator status, and primary dewar equipment capacities across candidate biobank relocation carrier plans.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Liquid Nitrogen Storage（NITRO）
information_points.content:
CSE-NITRO-TWS：Central cryo-farm sensor reports for the Apex CryoLogistics Cold-Chain Matrix document an on-site bulk liquid nitrogen inventory of 12000 L available for refilling.
CSE-NITRO-EFU：Regarding the Polaris Biovault Ground Transit System, bulk storage tank monitoring shows a bulk liquid nitrogen inventory of 15000 L available for refilling.
CSE-NITRO-37G：Sensor reports for the Boreal Specimen Express Protocol indicate an on-site bulk liquid nitrogen inventory of 18000 L available for refilling.

information_points.title: Evaluates mobile backup power autonomy, generator status, and primary dewar equipment capacities（CRYO）
information_points.content:
CSE-CRYO-SCZ：The Boreal Specimen Express Protocol provides dedicated backup power deployment yielding a continuous power autonomy of 48 h under full thermal load, alongside a maximum concurrent vapor-phase dewars capacity of 6 dewar units.
CSE-CRYO-PDN：The Polaris Biovault Ground Transit System includes dedicated backup power deployment with a continuous power autonomy of 36 h under full thermal load, and accommodates a maximum concurrent vapor-phase dewars capacity of 6 dewar units.
CSE-CRYO-17I：For the Apex CryoLogistics Cold-Chain Matrix, dedicated backup power deployment is confirmed via an onboard redundant diesel generator, providing a continuous power autonomy of 72 h under full thermal load. Trailer floor anchoring schematics establish a maximum concurrent vapor-phase dewars capacity of 8 dewar units.
